name: ivysilani-web-extension
description: Unofficial browser extension that improves the iVysílání video player of Česká televize.

scripts.firefox: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist
scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist --warnings-as-errors
scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist --filename "enhancer-for-ivysilani-{version}.xpi" --overwrite-dest
